decision.explanation: The available clinical timeline documents a prolonged period of disease control from age 53.039 to 57.108, with serial CT scans consistently reporting no cancer progression and stable CEA levels ranging from 1.3 to 2.0 ng/ml. Although the clinical record terminates at age 57.108, leaving an unmonitored interval of approximately 10 months before the queried age of 58.1, the documented trajectory strongly supports continued disease stability. Extrapolating from this sustained remission, progression within the subsequent 6 months is unlikely. However, the absence of direct monitoring data during the 10-month gap introduces inherent uncertainty regarding the disease status at age 58.1.
